date_policy: No lower publication-date limit is imposed; only the frozen cutoff date is applied.
language_policy: English publications only; non-English records remain in the retrieval denominator and are excluded with E_LANGUAGE_NON_ENGLISH.
objective: Derive publication-time scientific-paper innovation and potential-impact feature dimensions and indicators without preset dimension, query, or indicator counts.

count_symbols.M: candidate model dimensions derived from canonical indicator families

count_rule: K, Q, P, M, D, and F are outputs. No numeric quota or equal allocation per domain is permitted.

providers.OpenAlex: deterministic stratified evidence-saturation discovery, seed validation, and citation chaining

retrieval_design.bootstrap: deterministic sequential stratified sampling under saturation_protocol_v3.json
retrieval_design.formal: deterministic sequential stratified sampling plus complete seed and citation-network retrieval until dual novelty saturation
retrieval_design.claim_boundary: This is a saturation-based systematic evidence map, not an exhaustive census of every broad-query hit.

crossref_validation.year_rule: A year difference is retained as validated_date_variant when the DOI endpoint, normalized title similarity >=0.85, and document type all agree; it is an identity conflict only when DOI, title, or type also conflicts
crossref_validation.type_rule: OpenAlex article maps to Crossref journal-article or proceedings-article; OpenAlex review maps to journal-article
crossref_validation.effect: Only DOI/title/type identity conflicts and provider errors create a human queue; date variants remain explicit but do not exclude a record
crossref_validation.network_concurrency: At most four Crossref DOI metadata requests run concurrently; assessments are persisted by the main thread in frozen record order.
crossref_validation.resume_rule: Each record commits independently; validated, resolved, and queued-conflict records are not fetched again

open_fulltext_acquisition.eligibility: The OpenAlex location must explicitly report is_oa=true and expose a public HTTP(S) PDF URL
open_fulltext_acquisition.location_refresh: Only finally included English sources receive a resumable primary/best/all-location refresh; key values are never persisted
open_fulltext_acquisition.automation_boundary: Acquisition prepares and hashes candidate evidence only; it cannot verify English language, formulas, construct validity, or final inclusion
open_fulltext_acquisition.safety: Downloads are bounded, must have a PDF signature, are written atomically, and record final URL, content type, access statement, byte count, and SHA-256
open_fulltext_acquisition.content_verification: A verified UTF-8/PDF evidence file must contain both the normalized English construct/formula evidence span and the recorded author/affiliation evidence span; a reproducible formula must identify a page, table, equation, appendix, or section
open_fulltext_acquisition.resume_rule: A downloaded candidate is skipped only when its URL, local file, and SHA-256 still agree; failed attempts require an explicit retry

indicator_review_provenance.h1_boundary: H1 source dispositions and mention payloads are stored as independent blind review records before any H2 adjudication can be imported
indicator_review_provenance.h2_boundary: H2 may adjudicate only an existing H1 source review and H1 mention identity; H2 decisions are stored separately and then resolve the operational mention row
indicator_review_provenance.immutability: An H1 review cannot be overwritten after its H2 adjudication exists; source CSV snapshots and normalized per-role records are both retained
indicator_review_provenance.citation_boundary: Indicator sources enter citation tracking only after a separate H2 source review

redundancy_selection.ordering: frozen source-role priority, closed-vocabulary evidence strength, audited data readiness, evidenced 0-1 stability score, deterministic feature ID
redundancy_selection.priority_source: screening_rules_v3.json selection_priority_by_source_role; reviewers cannot choose another numeric value
redundancy_selection.stability_provenance: Every stability score requires a stability_basis describing the source/audit statistic and normalization; absent quantitative evidence is zero

bootstrap.development_seed_term_policy: Metric phrases copied from v2 formula_authorization are development_seed_hint records only; they may expand synonyms but cannot independently establish a domain or logical query. Authorizing development-seed terms must be re-extracted verbatim from a hydrated English title or abstract.

h2_required_for: all included and uncertain literature records
a DOI-hash deterministic 10 percent sample of concordant exclusions
all search-domain merge and split decisions
all candidate-dimension merge and split decisions
reviewers.import_enforcement: Each screening, term-coding, and dimension-coding import contains exactly one reviewer role; H2 is rejected until AI and H1 records exist, and primary records cannot be overwritten after H2 adjudication
reviewers.human_authorship_policy: H1 and H2 decisions require human review and adoption. A worksheet that originated as an automated draft is admissible only when the project owner explicitly attests that a human reviewed and adopted the exact hashed file; the import snapshot is then labelled review_import_human_attested_automated_draft. Such a file is treated as an H1/H2 decision but is not described as an originally manual or independently generated blind draft. Unreviewed automated H1/H2 files remain invalid. Human-task regeneration refuses to overwrite nonblank work, and imports reject the quarantine path and registered hashes of invalidated unreviewed artifacts.
reviewers.agreement_reporting_boundary: Agreement involving an attested human-reviewed automated draft may be calculated for workflow reconciliation, but must be labelled as concordance with the adopted reviewed draft and cannot substantiate independent blind manual generation.

formal_search_frame_gates: all active raw terms have a final coded disposition
every retained domain and logical query family has at least one directly source-verified evidence term; v2 pilot terms and development_seed_hint terms cannot independently authorize either
at least one eligible English H2-supplied hidden validation seed is registered

H2 completes an independent review search plus backward and forward citation tracking, and the union of all route-level eligible DOI lists exactly equals the imported eligible English hidden-validation seed set
all indexable English development and validation seeds are recalled or have a documented provider-level non-indexability reason
every active logical query family passes PRESS review by H2
zero-hit and logically redundant query families are archived with reasons
all physical queries map to a logical query family
formal_completion_gates: all frozen deterministic discovery batches selected before the H2-approved stopping round are completely retrieved
every retrieved record has a final screening disposition
all screening disagreements and H2 audit records are complete
all selected indicators have verified English full-text formula evidence with lawful source/access metadata and a frozen evidence-file SHA-256
H1 dispositions every included source and extracts indicator mentions; H2 reviews every source disposition and approves or excludes every retained mention
all selected indicators pass every hard gate

each retained predictive dimension has at least one selected indicator and support from two H2-verified normalized research-group identities whose author or affiliation evidence spans occur in frozen English full texts
H2 has separately approved at least three consecutive fully reviewed dual-zero rounds in the search-frame discovery phase and, after K/Q/P retrieval, in the formal indicator-discovery phase
all counts and source files have frozen hashes

literature_exclusion_reasons.E_LANGUAGE_NON_ENGLISH: Non-English title, abstract, or required full text
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_NOT_PAPER_LEVEL_INNOVATION_OR_POTENTIA: Does not study article-level innovation or potential scholarly impact
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_FUTURE_OUTCOME_ONLY: Discusses only post-publication outcomes without T0 predictors
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_NOT_ARTICLE_LEVEL: Unit of analysis is not an individual scientific paper
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_NOT_INDICATOR_PREDICTOR_VALIDATION: No indicator, predictor, determinant, definition, or validation evidence
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_DUPLICATE: Duplicate record under DOI, OpenAlex ID, or normalized title-year identity
literature_exclusion_reasons.E_INSUFFICIENT_METADATA: Title and abstract are insufficient for an eligibility decision
